briefdescription.para: Standalone benchmarks for HybridSearch (RRF, linear combination, score normalization).

detaileddescription.para:
These benchmarks use only in-process data structures (no live database I/O) to measure the algorithmic cost of:
reciprocalRankFusion() with varying candidate pool sizes
Linear combination fusion
normalizeScores() (BM25 and vector)
Config construction + validation overhead
Build: cmake build . target benchmark_hybrid_search config Release Run: ./benchmarks/benchmark_hybrid_search [benchmark_filter=...]
